settings.help: OFF by default. When enabled, delete repeated raw card-capture observations older than retention.raw_capture_days. Keep this off while historical card evidence is useful for audit, scam/phishing investigation, or later market/application analysis.
Age threshold used only when retention.prune_raw_captures_enabled is ON. Repeated raw card captures older than this are then deleted; canonical job evidence is controlled separately.
OFF by default. When enabled, archive stale jobs after retention.archive_after_days and clear bulky teaser/raw current-card text. Keep this off to preserve canonical card evidence indefinitely.
Age threshold used only when retention.archive_jobs_enabled is ON. Archiving clears bulky teaser/raw current-card text, so it is OFF by default to preserve evidence.

OFF by default. When enabled, remove detailed rows for already-archived jobs after retention.remove_archived_after_days, retaining only a neutral tombstone. This is intentionally opt-in because detailed history can support later analysis.

Age threshold used only when retention.remove_archived_jobs_enabled is ON. Detailed archived rows older than this are then replaced by small neutral tombstones. Must be greater than archive_after_days.
Normal freshness horizon for the shared daily market run. Keep at 1 day for SEEK and LinkedIn discovery; one-off bootstrap runs may explicitly request a wider window.
Initial SEEK navigation settling time before card-state polling begins.
Maximum bounded wait for a SEEK page to become a valid card page or explicit terminal page.
Maximum time JMM waits in the visible persistent SEEK browser for a genuine human/Cloudflare verification to clear before leaving the item retryable.
Runaway-loop protection only. Hitting this limit is a FAILED/incomplete run, never successful exhaustion.
Allowed shortfall between SEEK's first reported count and collected unique IDs before a leaf is marked incomplete. Small tolerance handles jobs appearing/disappearing during a live crawl.
Maximum SEEK-reported results allowed in one leaf partition before it must be split further. Default 450 keeps well below the approximate 500-result paging risk.
Maximum genuinely unfinished SEEK partitions processed per resumable state-crawl invocation. This bounds one agent/tool call; it is not a market coverage limit.

Safety overlap for extra SEEK runs inside the normal freshness window. If a previous fresh run completed recently, JMM scans back this many minutes before that run started, then stops only on exact ordered SEEK listing timestamps. Normal ~24-hour daily runs remain full passes.
Run resumable LinkedIn JobSpy/HTTP discovery after SEEK inside the same singleton collection process.
LinkedIn JobSpy results requested per query chunk. A full daily campaign resumes query offsets until complete or the shared runtime limit is reached.
Maximum time one LinkedIn JobSpy query may make no real pagination progress before that query fails retryably.
Timeout for one direct public LinkedIn vacancy-page HTTP fetch used for neutral JD/apply/repost/closed/applicant evidence.
Stop the current LinkedIn source stage after this many consecutive failed queries so a source outage does not hammer the remaining registry. Work stays resumable for the next run.
Minimum evidence score for recording a non-destructive possible duplicate link between two separately sourced job rows.
Allow title/employer/location plus rich card evidence to create possible-duplicate links. Exact same-source IDs remain deterministic regardless of this setting.
Default number of jobs returned by feed/search endpoints when a consumer does not specify a limit.
Maximum jobs returned in a single API page to keep consumer calls bounded.
Local-only API listen port used by the start script. Change here rather than editing Python.
Run the neutral overnight collection scheduler while the Job Market Map API service is running. Pause this to stop automatic overnight starts; Run Now remains available.
Local host hour (0-23) for the daily overnight collection window. WSL currently uses AEST/AEDT local time. Default 02:00.
Local minute for the daily overnight collection window. Combined with scheduler.daily_hour.
How long after the configured overnight time the scheduler may still start that day's run. Prevents a service started in the afternoon from unexpectedly launching a missed overnight crawl.
How often the in-app scheduler checks whether the overnight run is due. This does not control collection speed.
Maximum wall-clock time for one manual or scheduled market collection process across SEEK then LinkedIn. If reached, progress is preserved and the next run resumes it.
Create and integrity-check a SQLite online backup immediately before each manual or scheduled collection process. Strongly recommended.
Number of newest verified market.db backups retained in the local backups folder. Older backup files are removed after a successful new backup.
